chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from a number of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Ibrahim ibn Shayba, who said:

I wrote to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) asking him about completing the prayer in the two Sanctuaries, so he wrote to me: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) loved to increase prayer in the two Sanctuaries, so increase in them and complete [the prayer].'

key_terms.إِتْمَامِ الصَّلَاةِ: Completing the prayer (praying four rak'ahs instead of two)

ai.seo_question: How should one perform prayer in Mecca and Medina?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the ruling for travelers praying in the two major Sanctuaries (Mecca and Medina), instructing them to complete their four-rak'ah prayers rather than shortening them. This ruling is grounded in the Prophetic precedent of increasing voluntary and obligatory prayers in these holy sites, reflecting the unique spiritual status of the Harams. The hadith highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on emulating the Prophet’s specific practices in sacred spaces, distinguishing them from general travel rulings.
